blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of meals including breakfast plates, appetizers, pub fare, handhelds, entrees, and sweets. The pub offers a large selection of draft and bottled beers, wines, cocktails, spirits, and non-alcoholic drinks. They also host weekly and special events such as Yappy Hour and Slider Tuesday.
